Fix terraform deploy churn (#8607) (#8831)

## Summary

Fixes the ~14 resources that get modified on every terraform deploy even
when nothing has changed (#8607).

**Root cause:** `timestamp()` in the ECS task definition's
`DEPLOY_TIMESTAMP` env var generates a new value on every `terraform
apply`, forcing a new task definition revision. This cascades:

```
timestamp() changes every apply
    → container_definitions changes
    → aws_ecs_task_definition.app replaced (new revision ARN)
    → aws_ecs_service.app updated (references task def ARN)
    → aws_sfn_state_machine.scheduled_jobs[*] updated (definition JSON contains full task def ARN)
    → aws_sfn_state_machine.file_upload_jobs[*] updated (same)
    → aws_iam_policy.scheduler updated (depends on state machines)
    → aws_iam_policy.workflow_orchestrator updated (depends on state machines)
```

**Changes:**

- **Remove `DEPLOY_TIMESTAMP` env var** from ECS task definition
(`main.tf`). The API's `deploy_metadata.py` already has a fallback —
when `DEPLOY_TIMESTAMP` is absent, it uses the API process startup time
instead (which is a reasonable proxy, typically within seconds of
deploy)
- **Use `arn_without_revision`** in Step Functions state machine
definitions (`scheduled_jobs.tf`, `events_jobs.tf`). Instead of
hardcoding the full revision-specific ARN (e.g.,
`task-definition/api-staging:1745`), use the family ARN without
revision. Step Functions will automatically use the latest active task
definition revision. This is the same pattern already used in
`workflow_orchestrator_role.tf:82`

**Before:** Every deploy modifies ~14 resources (1 task def replaced + 1
destroyed + 1 service + 9 state machines + 2 IAM policies)
**After:** Deploys only modify resources when their configuration
actually changes (typically just task def + service when image/code
changes)

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `terraform plan` for API service in dev/staging — verify 0
changes when no config has changed
- [ ] Deploy with a new image tag — verify only task definition + ECS
service are modified
- [ ] Verify Step Functions scheduled jobs still execute correctly
(they'll auto-resolve to the latest task def revision)
- [ ] Verify healthcheck endpoint still returns `last_deploy_time` (now
uses API startup time as fallback)

Closes #8607

[Issue #8791] Fix SF-424a PDF output to include entries from Section B (#8811) ## Summary Fixes for #8791 ### What was broken `Budget424aSectionB` expects to read the entire SF-424A root object so it can build the **Section B table** from: - `activity_line_items[] `(activity columns 1–4) - `total_budget_categories` (column 5 totals) Inside the widget we derive the data using: ``` const rootFormDataFromContext = (formContext as { rootFormData?: unknown } | undefined)?.rootFormData; const rawValue: unknown = rootFormDataFromContext ?? value ?? {}; const activityItemsUnknown = get(rawValue as object, "activity_line_items"); ``` And they were all returning `undefined` from the Print Page On the print page (PrintForm → FormFields) was not passing any `formContext` into the widget tree: ``` formContext was undefined rootFormDataFromContext was undefined rawValue fell back to value ``` In RJSF widgets, value is only the value at the widget’s field path, not the full form data. In this case, value did not include `activity_line_items` at the top level, so: ``` activityItemsUnknown was undefined activityItems normalized to [] ``` This is why the logs showed nothing and why the table inputs for Section B couldn’t resolve the expected rows/columns. ### Fix `Pass the root data into formContext from the print page` so the widget can access the root form shape consistently: ``` ``` I've added some unit tests around context forwarding. ### Test Steps - Sign in - Do a search for `test` and look for `Test Opportunity for SF424A 1.0` - Fill out the form and save it - [verify] when you navigate to the print page (http://localhost:3000/print/application/[app_id]/form/[form_id]), that section B is not blank. ### Other Context The longer more involved fixed will be covered in this this [enhancement ticket](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-gov/issues/8818).
